75.name: GlobalConfig
75.docs:
Global user config. Only agent defaults — project-specific
settings live in `.autotune.toml`.

173.name: TargetMetric
173.docs:
A metric threshold that acts as a stop condition.

For `direction = Maximize`, stops when the metric value is `>= value`.
For `direction = Minimize`, stops when the metric value is `<= value`.

169.name: StopValue
169.docs: Either a finite number or "inf" for unbounded.

34.name: into
34.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

134.name: load
134.docs: Load config from a TOML file at the given path.

763.name: DEFAULT_MAX_FIX_ATTEMPTS
763.docs: Default fix-attempt budget when the config omits the field.

80.name: user_config_path
80.docs: Path to the user-level config file (~/.config/autotune/config.toml).

76.name: load
76.docs:
Load from the user config path (~/.config/autotune/config.toml).
Returns empty config if the file is missing.

172.name: target_metric
172.docs:
Stop when specific metrics reach absolute thresholds.
All listed metrics must meet their threshold (AND semantics).

135.name: validate
135.docs: Validate all config constraints. Called automatically by `load`.

764.name: DEFAULT_MAX_FRESH_SPAWNS
764.docs: Default fresh-respawn budget when the config omits the field.

762.name: max_fresh_spawns
762.docs:
Of the `max_fix_attempts` budget, how many may be fresh respawns
(context reset, new CLI invocation on the same worktree). `0`
disables fresh spawns (session-continuation only). `None` is
treated as the default by
[`AgentRoleConfig::effective_max_fresh_spawns`].

760.name: max_fix_attempts
760.docs:
Total implementer fix-retry turns allowed per iteration when tests
fail. Counts both session-continuation turns and fresh respawns.
`0` disables retry (tests fail → discard immediately, legacy
behavior). `None` (field absent) is treated as the default by
[`AgentRoleConfig::effective_max_fix_attempts`].

Only read off the `implementation` role; ignored elsewhere.

79.name: load_layered
79.docs:
Load from an ordered list of paths (earlier = lower priority).
Missing files are silently skipped.

77.name: load_from
77.docs: Load from a single explicit path. Returns empty config if file is missing.
